title: Northrop CEO Says Golden Dome Is More Affordable
title_cn: 诺斯罗普首席执行官表示金顶更便宜
summary: Northrop Grumman CEO Kathy Warden talks about working on the Golden Dome space defense system. She says the defense contractor will wind up with a "decent share" of the project. She speaks to Kailey Leinz at a Bloomberg Newsmakers event in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Canada Ready to Go Tariff-For-Tariff With US, Ford Says
title_cn: 福特称加拿大准备与美国加征关税
summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford said his war of words with President Donald Trump over tariffs got a little heated, but he had to "hit back." Ford says the US and Canada need a fair trade deal, but he says no deal is better than a bad deal. Ford speaks to Joe Mathieu on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Defense Industry Needs US Government Support on Rare Earths, Says Northrop Gruman CEO
title_cn: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司首席执行官表示，国防工业需要美国政府在稀土方面的支持
summary:
Kathy Warden, CEO of Northrop Gruman, said that the defense industry needs support from the US government to develop a supply chain that can provide critical rare earths. Warden said the government can work to 'bolster the resiliency' of the supply chain that relies largely on foreign sourcing.  Warden, who was in conversation with Bloomberg's Kailey Leinz, also discussed the US weapons stockpile, saying that the munitions space is going to be one of the fastest growing parts of the defense market. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)
